name: flycal-cli
title: flycal CLI MCP tools catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of flycal-cli commands for MCP servers. Each tool maps to a CLI invocation via the `command` template. Non-interactive tools are safe to run from an MCP host; interactive tools require a TTY and should be surfaced as guidance only or refused unless the client can attach a terminal.

calendar_default.description: Default Google Calendar ID used by search and as slots fallback. YAML null (~) means unset.

slots.templates.description: Named templates with days (1=Mon..7=Sun) and hours ranges. Default template is the first key (work).

slots.defaults.from.description: Default --from for slots (e.g. now or a date string)

slots.defaults.default_duration.description: Default slot duration when --duration is omitted (e.g. 45min)

slots.free_before.description: Buffer before each slot; events block this window before slot start

slots.free_after.description: Buffer after each slot; gaps must fit duration + free_after

slots.exclude_calendars.description: Calendar IDs whose events block free slots. If empty, calendar_default is used.

notes: flycal is read-only against Google Calendar (no create/update/delete of events).
Auth uses OAuth desktop flow; tokens live under ~/.flycal/.
Prefer quoting duration values that contain spaces (e.g. --in "3 days").
Duration formats without spaces also work (e.g. 30days, 48hours, 1h, 30min).

locale.description: Optional locale override for this invocation

tools.name: flycal_update
tools.title: Update flycal gem
tools.description: Run gem update flycal-cli to install the latest published version.

tools.name: flycal_login
tools.title: Connect Google account
tools.description: Start OAuth browser login for Google Calendar. Requires ~/.flycal/credentials.json and a browser. Interactive.

tools.name: flycal_logout
tools.title: Disconnect Google account
tools.description: Remove stored Google OAuth tokens and disconnect the account.

tools.name: flycal_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List available Google calendars as lines of "name id". Does not change configuration.

tools.name: flycal_config
tools.title: Configure flycal (interactive)
tools.description: Interactive configuration menu. Options: calendar_default (single select), exclude_calendars (multi-select, min 1), edit config (opens ~/.flycal/config.yml in $EDITOR or vi). Ctrl+C prints "config cancelled...". Prefer editing config.yml or using dedicated non-interactive flows from MCP hosts.

tools.name: flycal_search
tools.title: Search calendar events
tools.description: Search Google Calendar events. Prints one line per event (Calendar | Start | End | Title) plus a summary with total occupied time in hours/minutes and 8-hour working days. For ranges >7 days adds a weekly breakdown; for >30 days a monthly breakdown. Contains-filter on title/description when description is set. Read-only.

calendar.description: Calendar name or ID. Default: calendar_default from config.

from.description: Start datetime. Default: today midnight. Formats: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

to.description: End datetime. Default: 23:59 of day 30 from today. Ignored when `in` is set.

in.description: Duration from `from` (or now/from default), overrides `to`. Prefer no spaces or quote values: 30days, 48hours, 2months, 1year, or "30 days".

description.description: Case-insensitive contains filter on event summary or description.

tools.name: flycal_slots
tools.title: Find free time slots
tools.description: Find free slots using a config template (days + hours). Default template is the first one (work). Use --template dinner for evening hours. Subtracts busy events from slots.exclude_calendars. Starts from --from (default: now) for --in (default: 1 week). Duration defaults to 45min. Respects free_before/free_after. Output: header, template name, calendars, Google Calendar day link, continuous free ranges.

output.example:
found 3 slots
from wed 29 July 2026 to wed 5 August 2026
with duration 45min
for calendars
template work
Work
https://calendar.google.com/calendar/r/day/2026/7/29

friday 15/7
10 - 12
13 - 15.30

duration.description: Slot length. Default from config slots.defaults.default_duration (45min).

from.description: Start date/time. Default: now. YYYY-MM-DD always; with locale it also DD-MM-YYYY; with locale en also MM-DD-YYYY. Separators - or /. Optional time.

in.description: Search window from --from. Default: 1 week. Examples: 3 days, 1 week, 48 hours (quote if spaces).

template.description: Template name from slots.templates (default: first template, usually work).

calendar.description: Fallback calendar name/ID when exclude_calendars is not configured.

mcp_implementation_hints.execution: Spawn the flycal binary with argv from command.argv or build argv from option_map. Capture stdout/stderr and exit code. Return stdout as MCP text content.
mcp_implementation_hints.interactive_tools: Do not auto-run tools with interactive=true unless the host provides a TTY. Instead tell the user to run the command in a terminal.
mcp_implementation_hints.auth_errors: If stdout/stderr indicates the user is not connected, suggest flycal login.
mcp_implementation_hints.locale_arg: If input.locale is set, append --locale <value> to argv for any tool.
mcp_implementation_hints.tool_filter: Expose at least flycal_search, flycal_slots, flycal_calendars, and flycal_version for agent use.
